description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting leave requests, along with validation rules and related logic for access control and data handling.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class for handling employee leave request operations such as retrieval, creation, updating, and listing within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID, optionally returning detailed information based on query parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave requests based on search filters such as date range, status, subunit, and employee number.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for an employee using provided request data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave request, typically to change its status or perform actions like approval or rejection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a leave request, currently not implemented.
